exercises.prompt: How are active and passive participles distinguished in ALL derived verb forms (II–X)?
choices: Prefix مُـ with kasrah before C3 (active) vs. fatḥah before C3 (passive)
Prefix مَـ with wāw (مَفْعُولٌ) for all forms
Suffix ـِيٌّ for active vs. ـَةٌ for passive
exercises.answer: Prefix مُـ with kasrah before C3 (active) vs. fatḥah before C3 (passive)
exercises.explanation: Forms II–X all use مُـ; kasrah before the last radical marks the active participle (مُعَلِّمٌ), and fatḥah marks the passive participle (مُعَلَّمٌ).

feedback.rule: Derived participles (II–X): مُـ ... ـِـ (active) vs. مُـ ... ـَـ (passive).

exercises.prompt: Match each verb from root ع-ل-م to its derived form.
exercises.explanation: Root ع-ل-م demonstrates how augmentation shifts base meaning across Forms I, II, and V.
